load_pretrained_model: load a pre-trained fairseq model ensemble and task from a checkpoint file path
translate_sentences: translate a list of sentences using the GeneratorHubInterface translate method with beam search
score_sentences: score a list of sentences using the GeneratorHubInterface score method for reference evaluation
encode_decode_bpe: encode and decode text using the BPEHubInterface for byte-pair encoding operations
tokenize_detokenize: tokenize and detokenize text using the TokenizerHubInterface for text preprocessing
